_comment: Family notes seeded into the local brain (memory.js) by `npm run seed`. Add durable facts, preferences, and routines here. `text` is what gets recalled; `meta.agent` scopes a note to one specialist (finance, dev, resale, chef, security) - omit it for shared household facts the chief and everyone can see. Re-running the seed is safe: notes already present (by exact text) are skipped.

notes.text: Household members: Nic, Shelli, and Fox. Nic is the primary owner the assistant texts.
User-facing copy should be warm, direct, brief, and never use em dashes (family preference).

flyerdefense.com and disney.com are the family's work domains. Read their mail freely and add work addresses as calendar invitees freely; sending email TO a work domain is allowed but high-stakes, so it goes through the confirmation gate (policy changed 2026-06-20: no longer an absolute block).
Fox has no food allergy; the no-nuts rule is the daycare's policy, not an allergy.
Resale hunting is across Poshmark, eBay, Vestiaire, The RealReal, and 1stDibs.
No money movement: finance surfaces actions for a human to execute, it never pays or transfers.
